map.输入浇筑温度、环境温度、水化热温升、结构厚度，计算内表温差、基础温差与抗裂安全系: From placing temperature, ambient temperature, hydration heat rise and structure thickness, compute internal-external temperature difference, base temperature difference and anti-cracking safety factor, and assess thermal-cracking risk.
map.📖 查看「混凝土温度裂缝预防使用指南」: 📖 View Concrete Thermal Cracking Prevention Guide
map.💡 T_max=Tp+Tad·η；内表温差限 25°C，基础温差限 20~25°: 💡 T_max=Tp+Tad·η; internal-external limit 25°C, base limit 20~25°C; σ=E·α·ΔT·R·Kr/(1-ν), anti-cracking factor K=[σ]/σ, [σ]=E·εp
map.散热折减系数 η：薄板 0.4~0.5，厚大体积 0.6~0.8: Heat-dissipation factor η: thin slab 0.4~0.5, massive volume 0.6~0.8
map.约束系数 R 由厚度推定：h<1m 取 0.4，1~2m 取 0.5，2~4m: Restraint coefficient R from thickness: h<1m use 0.4, 1~2m use 0.5, 2~4m use 0.6, >4m use 0.7
map.松弛系数 Kr 考虑徐变松驰，一般取 0.4~0.6: Relaxation coefficient Kr accounts for creep relaxation, generally 0.4~0.6
map.抗裂安全系数 K≥1.15 视为安全，K<1 有开裂风险需温控: Anti-cracking safety factor K≥1.15 is safe; K<1 means cracking risk needing temperature control
map.分缝与冷却水管控温。: Control temperature by joints and cooling water.
map.寒潮表面保温防裂。: Surface insulation against cold waves to prevent cracking.
map.E=25 GPa、α=1e-5、ΔT=15℃ → σ=EαΔT=25e9×1e-: E=25 GPa, α=1e-5, ΔT=15°C → σ=EαΔT=25e9×1e-5×15=3.75 MPa, near tensile limit, needs temperature control.
map.ΔT 从 15 降到 8℃，应力降到 2.0 MPa 以下更安全，靠通水冷却与保: Lowering ΔT from 15 to 8°C drops stress below 2.0 MPa, safer, by water cooling and insulation.
map.为什么大体积易裂？: Why does mass concrete crack easily?
map.水化热积聚内外温差大，表面受约束产生拉应力超抗拉即裂。: Hydration heat builds a large internal-external gradient; surface restrained tensile stress exceeding tensile strength causes cracking.
map.低热水泥、分层浇筑、冷却管、表面保温与分缝释放约束。: Low-heat cement, layered casting, cooling pipes, surface insulation and joints to release restraint.

Input placing temperature, ambient temperature, adiabatic rise, structure thickness, etc. to compute the maximum internal temperature, internal-external and base temperature differences and thermal stress, give the anti-cracking safety factor, and assess mass-concrete cracking risk with temperature-control advice.
